description: This PHP source file defines a model class WorkWeekModel within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for representing a work week with properties for each day of the week. It is used in the context of the Leave plugin API to serialize and handle work week data.

classes.name: WorkWeekModel
classes.description: A model representing a weekly work schedule with properties for each day, used for serialization in the OrangeHRM leave API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the WorkWeekModel with a WorkWeek entity and sets the serialization filters for each day of the week.
